description: Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs - Appointed Mr. Amal Edirisuriya as competent authority of Muaythai Association of Sri Lanka
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a regulatory action taken by the Minister of Sports under the Sports Law, No. 25 of 1973. It suspends the registration of a sports association and appoints a competent authority, which constitutes a regulatory/legal measure rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content fits Legal/Regulatory (Type 5) as it involves the exercise of statutory powers under existing legislation to regulate a specific sector (sports).
